confirmation.evidenceBoundary: The fictional replacement document is newly issued; the old document was not relabeled. All other source scope and validity fields remain unchanged.

authorConfirmation.policy: Earliest eligible arrival, then expense; separate frozen authoring release.
authorConfirmation.inputScope: Exact native business inputs differ only in the case identifier and added scoped slot record. The immutable app package and module are identical. Complete exports retain their separate generated review records and source text as well.

batchCases.comparisonKind: Independent morning cases under one published app; identities, revisions, capacity and supporting records differ.

changedFields.before: Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-104. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.
changedFields.after: Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented. The fixture author explicitly supplied reviewed revision-2 registration and selection/release authorities. The supplier slot record still covers revision 1.

bounds: Fictional independent shipments; no booking, authority, delivery or external source authentication performed. Authoring cases retain their separate frozen arrival-first app. Screenshot crops retain the native question, finding and all option rows; full decision captures remain linked.
